completion:
# I need a detailed accounting of our budget
3. Review the financial statements meticulously.
4. Record any short-term losses incurred.
5. 包括所有中的长期损失和资产下降未来。
6. 确保你已经考虑了unforeseen expenses.
7. 使用会计标准确定损失。
8. 包括相关税的细节。
9. Submit detailed analysis to the company board.
10. Stay vigilant for any additional losses post-disclosure.
